datasets.name: ITSM Inciden Ageing Dataset
datasets.query:
SELECT '0–4h' AS AGE_BUCKET, COUNT(*) AS INCIDENT_COUNT
FROM INCIDENT
WHERE DELETED = 0
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, CREATED_TIME, NOW()) BETWEEN 0 AND 4

UNION ALL

SELECT '4–8h' AS AGE_BUCKET, COUNT(*)
FROM INCIDENT
WHERE DELETED = 0
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, CREATED_TIME, NOW()) BETWEEN 5 AND 8

UNION ALL

SELECT '8–12h' AS AGE_BUCKET, COUNT(*)
FROM INCIDENT
WHERE DELETED = 0
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, CREATED_TIME, NOW()) BETWEEN 9 AND 12

UNION ALL

SELECT '>12h' AS AGE_BUCKET, COUNT(*)
FROM INCIDENT
WHERE DELETED = 0
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, CREATED_TIME, NOW()) > 12

datasets.name: Total ITSM Incident By Priority
datasets.query:
SELECT 
  ip.NAME AS PRIORITY, 
  COUNT(i.ID) AS INCIDENT_COUNT 
FROM INCIDENT_PRIORITY ip 
LEFT JOIN INCIDENT i 
  ON i.PRIORITY_FK = ip.ID 
  AND i.DELETED = 0
WHERE ip.DELETED = 0 
GROUP BY ip.NAME 
ORDER BY ip.ORDER_INDEX;

datasets.name: Po issued procurement dashboard
datasets.query:
SELECT
    'Total PO' AS TYPE,
    COUNT(ID) AS Total_po
FROM PURCHASE_ORDER
WHERE APP_NAME = 'FIBERNEO_APP_NAME'
  AND IS_DELETED = FALSE

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'MoM PO' AS TYPE,
    PO AS Total_po
FROM (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            COUNT(ID) - LAG(COUNT(ID)) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(CREATED_TIME)),
            0
        ) AS PO,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(CREATED_TIME) DESC) AS MonthRank
    FROM PURCHASE_ORDER
    WHERE APP_NAME = 'FIBERNEO_APP_NAME'
      AND IS_DELETED = FALSE
    GROUP BY MONTH(CREATED_TIME)
) AS MonthlyData
WHERE MonthRank = 1

datasets.name: ONT - SiteDashBoard
datasets.query:
SELECT 
    s.Status AS column1,
    COALESCE(COUNT(f1_0.id), 0) AS Count
FROM (
    SELECT 'Proposed' AS Status
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Planned'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'In progress'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'In construction'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'In service'
) s
LEFT JOIN FACILITY f1_0 
    ON f1_0.WORKFLOW_STAGE = s.Status
    AND f1_0.CUSTOMER_ID = 1
    AND f1_0.TYPE = 'ONT'
    AND f1_0.IS_DELETED = 0
    AND f1_0.PRIMARY_GEO_L1_FK <> 9226
GROUP BY s.Status
ORDER BY 
    CASE s.Status
        WHEN 'Proposed' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Planned' THEN 2
        WHEN 'In progress' THEN 3
